use_cases: Navigating between different AI conversation branches in chat interfaces
Switching between multiple versions of AI-generated responses
Enabling users to explore parallel conversation paths in collaborative editing
Managing multi-turn dialogue branching for AI assistants
Providing navigation controls for content with multiple variations
ai_summary: A React context-based navigation component for managing conversation branches in AI chat interfaces. Provides previous/next navigation between content branches with state management, commonly used in AI-powered applications for exploring different response paths. The component uses a provider pattern with hooks for child components to access navigation state and methods.
